sources.title: CloudCLI UI deployment and workflow
sources.locator: Features; self-hosted npm; Desktop Companion; Docker Sandboxes experimental
sources.finding: Documents browser/mobile layouts, native provider sessions, stage/commit Git explorer, local/server installation, desktop companion and a separate experimental Docker Sandbox route.

sources.title: Coding-provider adapter contracts
sources.locator: Provider module overview and adapter architecture
sources.finding: The codebase separates authentication, session and runtime implementations for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Agent and OpenCode. Models are not counted as additional harnesses.

sources.title: Claude Code runtime adapter
sources.locator: Claude Agent SDK query and runtime options
sources.finding: The adapter invokes the Claude Agent SDK with local CLI/runtime options, streamed events and provider permissions.

sources.title: Codex runtime adapter
sources.finding: The adapter uses Codex SDK/app-server sessions, events and approvals. It is a coding-harness integration rather than a generic OpenAI chat endpoint.

sources.title: Cursor Agent launch implementation
sources.locator: crossSpawn cursor-agent; resume and prompt arguments
sources.finding: Launches the actual cursor-agent process with session-specific prompt/resume arguments.

sources.title: OpenCode runtime implementation
sources.finding: Creates an OpenCode server and manages its session prompts, events and approvals; the installed OpenCode CLI has a documented minimum version.

sources.title: Claude authentication status
sources.finding: Detects CLI credentials and API-key-style environment/settings credentials with explicit priority.

sources.title: Codex authentication status
sources.finding: Reads the native Codex auth file for OAuth tokens or an API-key fallback.

sources.title: Desktop and CLI implementation metadata
sources.locator: package version; bin; Electron dependencies/build targets
sources.finding: The public package defines the cloudcli service CLI and Electron desktop companion build targets.

sources.title: Electron companion implementation
sources.finding: The desktop main process uses Electron BrowserWindow and local/remote CloudCLI environment connections.

sources.title: Displayed Git diff interface
sources.finding: The UI renders actual bounded patch text with added/removed-line styling, rather than only filenames or change counts.

sources.title: Product Git operations
sources.finding: The service stages selected files and creates local Git commits with a supplied message; diff handlers feed the review interface.

sources.title: Worktree merge interface
sources.finding: The modal exposes local branch merge/squash and optional worktree cleanup.

sources.title: Local worktree merge boundary
sources.finding: Requires clean source and target worktrees, merges/squashes into the main worktree branch and aborts on conflicts. It does not implement remote PR approval policy.

sources.title: Persisted scheduled messages
sources.finding: Stores text, session and absolute ISO scheduled time, bounded to one year ahead.

sources.title: Scheduled-message execution
sources.finding: The service poll claims due messages and runs detached chat turns. A due scheduled send deliberately interrupts an active run; failed/unavailable sends are recorded, not silently retried.

sources.title: Official n8n integration
sources.locator: CloudCLI n8n node; POST /api/v1/agent/execute; API-key authentication
sources.finding: Documents externally triggered n8n workflows calling CloudCLI agent execution. The event/cron source remains n8n, distinct from the product scheduled-message service.

sources.title: CloudCLI Cloud plans and environment behavior
sources.finding: The hosted service offers persistent Docker environments, independent concurrent agents and subscription/API-key routing. Prices are Hobby€7/month, Growth€20/month, Team€39/month. New accounts get24 runtime hours to use within two days without a card.

sources.title: Hosted CloudCLI privacy policy
sources.locator: Last updated November3,2026; scope; usage/device data; processors; cookies
sources.finding: This policy explicitly excludes self-hosted open-source UI. Hosted usage/device/error events use server logs and PostHog EU, alongside account/environment content. Browser cookie blocking is described, but not a complete telemetry off switch.

sources.title: CloudCLI UI source license
sources.locator: AGPLv3 text; Section7 additional terms; relicensing notice
sources.finding: Current UI contributions are AGPL-3.0-or-later with attribution/misrepresentation/publicity/trademark terms. Older third-party GPLv3 contributions are incorporated under GPL Section13; hosted-service implementation parity is not established.
